versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the skill to open Hugging Face in the user's Brave browser.
- Reuses existing Hugging Face tab/session when possible to avoid duplicates.
- Navigates to the Hugging Face homepage and verifies the correct site is loaded.
- Maintains user's existing authenticated session; does not handle credentials.
- Informs the user if login is required.
- Does not perform any content modifications or account changes.
